lines.description: 2 to 4 short sentences: the thinking, key idea first.

keys.description: 1 to 5 concrete data items from the inputs, 1 to 3 words each.

title.description: What is being designed or decided, 8 words at most.

action.description: Main button label of the resulting screen, 2 to 4 words, verb first.

memory.description: The memory drawn on, copied exactly, or an empty string.

trace.description: Up to 4 Engram nodes you actually drew on (ids in brackets in the dossier), each with a 2 to 4 word reason; empty without an Engram.
